headline: I think... for products and people | Building, Ordit

sections.bio:
I share:
▪️bts of building my product-led & lifecycle agency, Ordit, from scratch
▪️tools and products I use (or test) in my process(es)—this is where your product comes in.

💌For partnerships & collaborations, reach out at [email protected]

sections.title: What I offer
sections.body: Sponsored posts (text-only, carousels), product teardowns, and multi-post campaigns.

sections.title: How I work
sections.body:
1. You brief me
2. I study your product
3. I find the unique usecase that fits my process
4. I incorporate it in my process
5. Then, I talk about it as naturally as I'd describe my day

sections.title: Why work with me
sections.body: I don't fake enthusiasm for products I don't get or find useful. If there's an angle worth talking about, I'll find it.
